title: What’s new
changes: Added an optional Fire danger districts map overlay, shaded by the official NSW RFS rating for each district.
Added council-selectable Fire Danger Ratings and Total Fire Ban information using the official NSW RFS feed, with shared server-side caching.
Added an administrator setting to disable the What’s New popup instance-wide.
Started the settings-page redesign with a responsive category navigator and an always-accessible save and restart bar.
Classified Backyard Fire and FIRECALL pager messages as High priority.
Added administrator-defined Critical, High and Medium incident keywords, with comma or line-separated matching.
Added an optional Live map setting that hides pager messages identified as tests, drills, training or exercises without removing them from Feed or Incidents.
Fixed Australian RFS feed dates being interpreted as US dates, which prevented valid pager and official-incident matches.
Fixed WaterNSW dam storage retrieval and moved its cache into persistent application data so all visitors share the scheduled API refreshes.
Limited WaterNSW retries to one request per configured refresh window and kept current dam levels available if the optional trend request fails.
Limited the message search and pagination controls to the Feed page across every theme.
Added optional NASA FIRMS satellite hotspots to the live map, with server-side caching and an independent layer switch.
Added an optional NPWS incident source with automatic folding into matching RFS incidents.
Redesigned incident map popups with warning status, incident details, units paged and a direct incident-timeline action.
Added configurable stop-message correlation so short cancellation pages can join the correct incident timeline.
Improved RFS and VRA incident correlation using shared incident numbers and addresses.
Added a dedicated Fire and Rescue NSW agency icon and normalised agency-logo sizing.
Administrators can now protect their accounts with authenticator-app two-factor authentication and recovery codes.
Added the Bushfire theme and theme-aware Operations Display.
Added selectable PWA icons and neutral link previews.
Added a configurable watermarked login background.
Made push notifications open the matching capcode feed.
Added search to the push-notification capcode picker.
Grouped push-notification controls into a clearer admin settings panel.
Added automatic local service health and admin-managed remote receivers.
Redesigned the admin dashboard and grouped all settings into consistent panels.
